title: Symphony or Solo? Xi's AI Alliance, DeepMind's FINRA Pitch, and the $50 Barrel of Intelligence
description: Xi Jinping launches a 29-nation AI alliance aimed at global governance, and Demis Hassabis pitches Washington on a FINRA-style vetting body for frontier models. Plus: Chamath Palihapitiya says the AI pricing wars are coming, DeepMind's CEO on why STEM still matters, and a troubling finding about AI models and authoritarian regimes.
